description: Implement the reminders pipeline: when a booking becomes SCHEDULED, enqueue two delayed reminder jobs (T-24h and T-15m) with deterministic ids; the jobs re-read booking state at run time and skip if the booking is no longer SCHEDULED (cancelled/rescheduled); retry policy is exponential backoff with 5 attempts; after the final failure mark the message FAILED, notify the influencer, and flag the booking in the dashboard (booking.lastError). This is the core of the Phase 5 'Done when: a forced failure retries then alerts' requirement. Depends on FEAT-002 (messaging substrate + Message table).
steps: In lib/queue.ts add a REMINDER_QUEUE constant (e.g. 'reminders') and a REMINDER_ATTEMPTS = 5 constant. Add deterministic id helpers reminderJobId(kind, bookingId) producing exactly `reminder-24h-<bookingId>` and `reminder-15m-<bookingId>` (the spec mandates these exact id formats so jobs can be removed/replaced on reschedule/cancel).

In lib/queue.ts add enqueueReminders(bookingId, startTime) that adds both reminder jobs to REMINDER_QUEUE with jobId = reminderJobId(...), attempts:5, backoff exponential delay 5000, removeOnComplete {age 7d}, removeOnFail:false, and a computed `delay` = max(0, startTime - 24h - now) and max(0, startTime - 15m - now) respectively. Skip adding a reminder whose fire time is already in the past (e.g. a booking scheduled <15m before start). Job data: { bookingId, kind: '24h'|'15m' }.

In lib/queue.ts add cancelReminders(bookingId): for each of the two deterministic ids, getJob and remove it if present (regardless of state) so reschedule/cancel drop stale reminders. Follow the requeueCreateMeeting getJob/remove idiom.

Wire enqueueReminders into the SCHEDULED transition. In lib/meeting.ts createMeetingForBooking, right after the booking is successfully marked SCHEDULED (the updateMany with count>0) and alongside enqueueSendMessage, call an injectable deps.enqueueReminders(bookingId, session.startTime). Add enqueueReminders to MeetingDeps + defaultDeps (default -> lib/queue enqueueReminders) so existing meeting tests can inject a fake. Reminders must only be enqueued once the booking is actually SCHEDULED (never at PAID/enqueue time).

Create lib/reminders.ts with sendReminderForBooking(bookingId, kind, overrides?) mirroring lib/meeting.ts: re-read the latest booking at run time; if status !== 'SCHEDULED' (cancelled, rescheduled to a new event, completed, failed) log and return a 'skipped' outcome WITHOUT sending; otherwise send the reminder message via the FEAT-002 messaging layer with template `reminder-24h` or `reminder-15m` (reuse sendMessageForBooking or a thin wrapper so WhatsApp->SMS fallback and the Message row are reused); return outcome 'sent'|'skipped'. Expose ReminderDeps for injection (sendMessage, prisma access via lib/db, alert) following MeetingDeps.

Create worker/jobs/sendReminder.ts: BullMQ handler for the reminder job calling sendReminderForBooking(job.data.bookingId, job.data.kind); wrap unrecoverable domain errors in UnrecoverableError, rethrow transient ones for backoff (mirror worker/jobs/createMeeting.ts and sendMessage.ts).

Register a reminders Worker in worker/index.ts on REMINDER_QUEUE following the meetings shape: REDIS_URL guard, concurrency, error + failed listeners, graceful shutdown close. The `failed` handler: on exhausted attempts (attemptsMade >= opts.attempts) and not UnrecoverableError, call reportMessageFailure (from FEAT-002) for the reminder's template so the final failure marks the message FAILED, alerts the influencer, and flags booking.lastError. Add basic logging for each reminder outcome and failure (the spec's 'Basic logging/alerts for failed jobs').

Add tests/reminders.test.ts (node:test, inject fakes - no Redis/DB needed for the logic paths): reminder job on a SCHEDULED booking sends; reminder job on a CANCELLED booking is skipped and sends nothing (proves run-time status read); enqueueReminders computes correct delays and uses the exact `reminder-24h-<id>` / `reminder-15m-<id>` job ids; a reminder whose fire time is already past is not enqueued; cancelReminders removes both ids. Use a fake queue object (add/getJob/remove recorders) to assert ids/delays without a real Redis.
acceptance_criteria: lib/queue.ts exports reminderJobId producing exactly `reminder-24h-<bookingId>` and `reminder-15m-<bookingId>`, plus enqueueReminders and cancelReminders
enqueueReminders schedules T-24h and T-15m delayed jobs with attempts:5 and exponential backoff delay 5000, skipping any already-past fire time
lib/meeting.ts enqueues reminders only after the booking is marked SCHEDULED, via an injectable MeetingDeps.enqueueReminders
lib/reminders.ts sendReminderForBooking re-reads booking status at run time and skips when status !== SCHEDULED
worker/index.ts registers the reminders Worker and, after exhausted attempts, marks the message FAILED + alerts the influencer + flags booking.lastError
tests/reminders.test.ts asserts the deterministic ids, the past-fire-time skip, the cancelled-booking skip, and cancelReminders removal
verification: Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck lib/queue.ts lib/reminders.ts lib/meeting.ts worker/jobs/sendReminder.ts worker/index.ts` and confirm no real errors (unresolved '@/...'/'bullmq'/'@/generated/prisma' are environment noise). Fix every real error.
Read lib/reminders.ts and confirm the status is read from a fresh prisma query inside the function, not from job data, and that a non-SCHEDULED booking returns before any send call.
Read enqueueReminders and confirm job ids are literally `reminder-24h-<bookingId>` and `reminder-15m-<bookingId>` and attempts/backoff match CREATE_MEETING_ATTEMPTS style.
NOTE for CI (cannot run here): `npm test` reminders + meeting tests must pass after install + prisma generate.
findings: Implemented the Phase 5 reminders pipeline on top of the FEAT-002 messaging layer. lib/queue.ts: added REMINDER_QUEUE='reminders', REMINDER_ATTEMPTS=5, ReminderKind='24h'|'15m', reminderJobId(kind,bookingId) producing exactly `reminder-24h-<id>`/`reminder-15m-<id>`, enqueueReminders(bookingId,startTime) that adds BOTH delayed jobs (delay = start - offset - now for 24h/15m, attempts:5, exponential backoff delay 5000, removeOnComplete age 7d, removeOnFail:false, data {bookingId,kind}) and SKIPS any reminder whose delay<=0 (already-past fire time), and cancelReminders(bookingId) following the requeueCreateMeeting getJob/remove idiom. DESIGN NOTE: enqueueReminders/cancelReminders take an optional ReminderQueue parameter (defaults to the real BullMQ queue via getQueue) so tests can inject a fake recorder and assert ids/delays without Redis; the default is only evaluated when the arg is omitted, so production behavior (requires REDIS_URL) is unchanged. lib/meeting.ts: added enqueueReminders to MeetingDeps + defaultDeps (default -> lib/queue enqueueReminders) and call deps.enqueueReminders(booking.id, session.startTime) ONLY after the idempotent updateMany marks the booking SCHEDULED (count>0), right alongside enqueueSendMessage; never at PAID/enqueue time. lib/reminders.ts: sendReminderForBooking(bookingId,kind,overrides?) mirrors the meeting DI pattern. It re-reads the booking status at run time via injectable deps.findBooking (default = fresh prisma query selecting id+status) and returns 'skipped' WITHOUT sending when the booking is missing or status!=='SCHEDULED' (powers the 'rescheduled booking sends only the new reminders' outcome); otherwise it sends template `reminder-24h`/`reminder-15m` through deps.sendMessage (default sendMessageForBooking) so the WhatsApp->SMS fallback and the deterministic Message row are reused. ReminderDeps exposes findBooking/sendMessage/alert. worker/jobs/sendReminder.ts: BullMQ handler calling sendReminderForBooking(job.data.bookingId, job.data.kind), logging the outcome, mirroring sendMessage.ts (transient delivery failures propagate for backoff; the messaging layer already distinguishes skip vs throw). worker/index.ts: registered a reminders Worker on REMINDER_QUEUE with the meetings/send-message shape (REDIS_URL guard, concurrency 5, error+failed listeners, graceful shutdown close). Its failed handler, on exhausted attempts (attemptsMade >= opts.attempts) and not UnrecoverableError, calls reportMessageFailure (FEAT-002) with template `reminder-${kind}` so the final failure marks the Message FAILED + sets booking.lastError + alerts the influencer; per-outcome and per-failure logging added. tests/reminders.test.ts (node:test, pure-logic, injected fakes, no Redis/DB): SCHEDULED->sends reminder-24h; CANCELLED->skipped sends nothing (proves run-time status read); missing booking->skipped; enqueueReminders produces exactly reminder-24h-<id>/reminder-15m-<id> with attempts:5, exponential backoff 5000 and ~24h/~(48h-15m) delays; a 10-min-out booking enqueues neither (both past); a 2h-out booking enqueues only reminder-15m; cancelReminders removes both ids and is a no-op when absent. VERIFICATION: `unset NODE_OPTIONS && tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck lib/queue.ts lib/reminders.ts lib/meeting.ts worker/jobs/sendReminder.ts worker/index.ts tests/reminders.test.ts` (global TS 5.9.2) shows no real errors; only expected environment noise (TS2688 missing @types, TS2307 unresolved '@/...'/bullmq/next/ioredis) because node_modules is empty and the Prisma client cannot be generated here. `npm run typecheck`/`npm test` and Redis/Postgres could not run (npm registry blocked, no services) - CI must run them after merge.
